instruction: Look at guih11_window_elevation_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. Launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih11_window_elevation_seed.dxf`. Complete the hard window elevation. Draw FRAME rectangle (0,0)-(2400,1600), vertical mullions (800,0)-(800,1600) and (1600,0)-(1600,1600), transom (0,600)-(2400,600), SWING diagonals (40,640)-(760,1560), (840,640)-(1560,1560), and (1640,640)-(2360,1560), SWING arcs radius 360 at centers (40,640), (840,640), and (1640,640), three HATCH glass fills in the lower panels, and labels WINDOW W-204, 2400, 1600, and GLASS TYP. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih11_window_elevation_completed.dxf.
